name: link_knowledge_base_answer
title: Link knowledge base answer
description: Link a knowledge base answer to a ticket of Zammad, as the ticket view does. Name the ticket by its ticket_number, ticket_id or ticket_url, and the answer by its answer_id, as a knowledge base search found it, with the locale of its text where the search named one. get_ticket then lists the answer as linked. A link is neither changed nor removed here — the user does that in Zammad.

ticket_number.description: The ticket number as shown in Zammad, e.g. "31042" or "Ticket#31042".

ticket_id.description: The internal ID of the ticket, e.g. 8812.

ticket_url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

answer_id.description: The ID of the knowledge base answer.

locale.description: The locale whose text to link, e.g. "de-de", as a search named it: a preference. Where the answer has no text in it, its text in the agent's locale, else in the primary one is linked; answer.locale in the result says which. Leave it out for the agent's own.

url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

ticket.description: The ticket that got the link.

url.description: Link to the answer in Zammad.

answer.description: The answer, in the locale of the text linked.

linked_before.description: The two were linked already; nothing changed.
